contact.basis: Unraised west forecourt beyond the entrance steps; DGM1 reveals the previous [1.6,64] point was on the raised stair landing.

verticalDatum: Berlin DGM1 DHHN2016 elevations in meters; local reference at west forecourt, not a site survey benchmark
attribution: © Geoportal Berlin, ATKIS DGM1; Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0
method: Original 1 m DGM1 XYZ elevations, cell centers at half-meter EPSG:25833 coordinates, transformed from the signed local model frame with PROJ and bilinearly sampled into the 4 m review grid. No flattening, fitting, clipping or alteration of source heights.
limitations: Review sampling is 4 m; source ground grid is 1 m. Fine stair and foundation contact is generalized.
DGM1 ground beneath buildings is interpolated by the source provider. No site survey accuracy is claimed.
Other runtime DEMs can differ from this independently preserved Berlin DGM1 review.
